description: Style anchor for Home Field hub art. Every imagegen prompt MUST include this description verbatim under a `Style anchor` block so terrain, props, exits, chibi, and effects read as one cohesive world.

style.world: Mycelium fungal forest meadow, dark-fairytale fantasy, organic and bioluminescent

palette.primary: lush deep green grass with mossy variations (#3a6e3a, #4d7d4f, #2b5a3a)
palette.accents: amber bioluminescence (#d99a2b, #f0c050), violet spore glow (#7a4cb8, #b07ed8), bone neutrals (#e8dfc8)
palette.shadows: warm umber tones, not pure black (#2a1f1a)

style.lighting: Single top-left key light with warm amber rim. Soft ambient fog. Perpetual dusk; no harsh sun, no hard cast shadows.
style.outline: Clean medium-weight outline, slightly darker than the local fill (not pure black). No outline on terrain tiles; clear outline on props and exits.
style.shadowStyle: Subtle elliptical drop shadow under ground entities (props, chibi, exits) using semi-transparent warm umber. No long cast shadows.
style.ambient: Drifting spores, soft amber motes, gentle violet glow on certain mushroom caps and the Arena arch. Tone is calm, inviting, slightly magical — not menacing.
style.scale: 2.5D top-down RPG camera angle, slightly elevated so character heads are visible while feet plant on the ground. Mushrooms taller than the chibi.

rejections: No medieval stone, no sci-fi, no urban props
No bright cartoon colors, no neon, no rainbow palettes
No high-contrast pure-black outlines or pure-white highlights
No realistic photography or photoreal textures
No text in the images themselves — signposts are art-only; text is rendered at runtime
No human-only figures with mushroom hats; chibis are mushroom-elf heroines with visible elf ears when ears are shown
sources: docs/home-field-ingame-plan.md (Visual Concept and Visual And Scale Lock sections)
